# Neowave

> Neowave is a web and AI company in Hama, Syria. It sets up a company's online presence: a website built at no upfront cost, a WhatsApp Business account, social media accounts, a Google Maps listing, a visual identity and ready-to-post ad images. The company pays a small monthly subscription that covers hosting, a domain, weekly backups and small edits.

## What every presence setup includes

- Website: a phone-first site in Arabic and English that shows what the company offers and makes it easy to call or message.
- WhatsApp Business: a proper business account with profile, catalogue, greeting and quick replies.
- Social media accounts: Facebook, Instagram and the Google Maps listing, set up with the right name, logo, hours and contact details.
- Visual identity: logo, colours and fonts applied consistently across the website, profiles and covers.
- Social media ad images: ready-to-post designs for offers and announcements, sized for each platform.

## Separate services

- Booking system: customers book an appointment or order themselves.
- AI chat agent and automation: answers common questions, takes orders, connects to existing tools.
- Custom social media app.
- Digital characters that represent the brand.

## Packages (USD per month when billed yearly; month-to-month price in brackets)

- Starter, 9.99 (29.99): website, hosting, domain, Google Maps listing, WhatsApp Business profile, weekly backup, 3 small edits a month.
- Business, 19.99 (59.99), most popular: everything in Starter plus an online booking system, Facebook and Instagram set up, a visual identity kit, 2 ad images a month, 5 small edits a month.
- Growth, 39.99 (99.99): everything in Business plus a customer CRM (records, follow-ups, history), 4 ad images a month, a monthly check-in on profiles and listing, 10 small edits a month.

Building the website itself is free. Paying yearly saves more than 60% compared with paying month by month.

## How it starts

1. The company sends its details through the contact form.
2. Neowave replies on WhatsApp to learn about the company.
3. Neowave builds the website and sets up WhatsApp Business, the social accounts and the identity.
4. The company reviews everything and it goes live.

## Pages

- Arabic (default): / (home), /terms, /privacy
- English: /en (home), /en/terms, /en/privacy

## Location

Hama, Syria. Languages: Arabic and English.
